    AI Overview
    Kennesaw State University (KSU) is a top-tier R2 public research university in Georgia with over 51,000 students across campuses in Kennesaw and Marietta. Known for over 190 academic programs and competitive NCAA Division I sports (Conference USA), KSU is among Georgia's largest universities, focusing on research in technology, health, and community development. 
    Key Details About Kennesaw State University: 
    • Location: Two locations in Metro Atlanta: Kennesaw (main) and Marietta.
    • Academics: Offers over 190 undergraduate and graduate degrees, including engineering, nursing, and business programs.
    • Research: Designated as a Carnegie R2 doctoral research institution.
    • Admissions: Moderately selective, with a ~69% acceptance rate and a 3.2+ GPA requirement for test-optional admission through summer 2026.
    • Athletics: Competes as the Kennesaw State Owls in NCAA Division I Conference USA.
    • Student Life: Features over 100 student organizations, Greek life, and the Marching Owls. 
    Campus Highlights: 
    • Kennesaw Campus: Features a massive student center, green spaces, and a "University Green."
    • Marietta Campus: Home to the College of Architecture and Engineering, formerly Southern Polytechnic State University.
    • Dining/Services: Known for extensive dining facilities and robust on-campus housing options. 
    For more specific information, prospective students can explore academic programs on KSU's website or take a virtual tour.
